Privacy Policy

Free QR Studio supports browser-based QR generation. Static QR content can be generated locally in the browser. If you create a dynamic QR account, account and QR-record data are stored by the configured Supabase project, and dynamic scans create analytics events needed to provide the redirect and reporting service.

Data we may process

  • Account email and authentication identifiers for account features.
  • Dynamic QR target URL, name and status.
  • For dynamic scans: timestamp, user-agent, referrer and a salted hash of the request IP for aggregate measurement.
  • Third-party advertising data only when ads are enabled and their provider scripts are loaded.

Retention and deletion

Retention depends on the configured database and ad providers. Account holders can request deletion through the service contact channel. Before launch, the operator should set retention periods and complete jurisdiction-specific legal review.

Third parties

Optional services may include Supabase, the QR library CDN and an advertising provider. Their applicable privacy terms also apply.
